question: _______ is the deepest landlocked and well-protected port in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishakhapatnam port**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Visakhapatnam__ Port is the deepest land-locked and protected port located in Andhra Pradesh.

Whereas, The Gwadar Port is the deepest seaport of the world, situated on the Arabian Sea at Gwadar in Balochistan province of Pakistan
